metadata.title: दुमका में संविधान और आरक्षण पर बहस ठहरी | Constitution and ST Reservation are core issues
metadata.description: On May 10th, Sita Soren, a seasoned politician and BJP candidate, submitted her nomination papers amidst a show of support from Defence Minister Rajnath Singh. Accusing the opposition of disseminating falsehoods regarding the BJP's stance on Scheduled Tribe (ST) reservations and the nation's constitution, Sita Soren rallied her supporters during a public meeting following her nomination. Meanwhile, Kalpana Soren, the spouse of Hemant Soren and daughter-in-law of JMM stalwart Shibu Soren, took to the podium in a spirited rally backing Nalin Soren, the JMM candidate. Kalpana voiced allegations that her husband's incarceration by the BJP was a deliberate ploy to hinder the JMM and India alliance. Watch our ground report from Dumka, Jharkhand.
